entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-22
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Remove API that was marked obsolete in <= .NET 8 #62867
    .NET 11 Planning
  • SignalR client not reporting version correctly #62864
  • Allow @await blocks in blazor markup #62863
  • Support excluding selected object properties/parameters from validation #62862
  • Reloading the InteractiveServer page consecutively throws circuit shutdown error #62860
  • PersistentState attribute throws InvalidOperationException at runtime when used with private property #62859
  • Critical Bug: Blazor Server – SignalR NullReferenceException when closing modal and updating QuickGrid #62858
  • Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds (a[href$="Downloads/"]): A11y_ASP.NETCore_Index_AI4W. #62856
  • Improve disposal of Blazor server resources for disconnected clients #62855
    10.0-rc1
  • [Templates] Https changes broke the application URL for blazor #62852
  • CI template tests are not running with the same sdk version #62851
  • Perf regression: fortunes #62850
  • Perf improvement: fortunes_ef, fortunes_ef, kestrel-encoded-url #62848

Closed

  • gRPC implementation on Unix sockets is not compatible with Go #47043
  • Remove obsoleted ASP.NET Core APIs #62794
  • Quarantine InteropTests.InteropTests.UnimplementedMethod #60357
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #62849
  • [.NET 10] Generating OpenAPI spec in `yaml` format seems to be broken #62821
  • Make sure exceptions from `OnNavigateTo` are logged #62413
    10.0-preview7

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0-preview7] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62869
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • Add gRPC JSON transcoding option for case insensitive field names #62868
    area-grpc
  • Add PQC certificate support for HTTPS #62866
    area-networking
  • Fix RequestDelegateFactory to handle nullable types correctly in empty request body scenarios #62861
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Fix Blazor template HTTPS profile to include HTTP URL #62853
    Attention: Shared Code Modified

Merged

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #62865
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops, 10.0-preview7
  • [release/10.0-preview7] Passkey design follow-ups #62841
    Servicing-approved
  • Wrap OnNavigateTo callback with GetErrorHandledTask for proper exception logging #62414
    area-blazor, Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-preview7
  • Follow-up on IsLocalhost TLD local dev #62838
    community-contribution, area-networking, 10.0-preview7

Updated

  • chore: create issue template & workflow to automatically open issue for browser testing dependencies updates (Selenium / Playwright) #62845
    area-infrastructure, dependencies, build-ops
  • Use sdk paths! #62619
    area-infrastructure
  • [SignalR] [Java] Fix NPE when closing hub connection during negotiation #62319
    area-signalr, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun, 10.0-preview7
  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 1159: Build ID 2755629 #62733
    area-mvc
  • Mark WebHostBuilder class as obsolete #62785
  • Revert "Revert "Upgrade Ubuntu and Azure Linux VMs and Containers"" #62304
    area-mvc
  • Fixed race condition in the disposing of the QuickGrid #62840
    area-blazor
  • [Blazor] Update AuthenticationStateProvider to use declarative persistent component state #62063
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Replace unload event with pagehide for sending disconnect beacon from Blazor client #62805
    area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
  • Add visibility change beacon and circuit cleanup heuristic for Blazor Server #62789
    area-blazor
  • Add CreateScopeForStatusCodePages to Blazor templates #62843
    area-blazor, Attention: Shared Code Modified, 10.0-rc1
  • [release/10.0-preview7] Support all subscribers to `OnNotFound` event #62835
    Servicing-consider, area-blazor, 10.0-preview7
